tasks.title: Scaffold apps/api package manifest, tsconfig, and vitest config
tasks.description: Create apps/api as the Hono backend workspace package: package.json (name @medbridge/api, type=module, scripts test=vitest run, typecheck=tsc -b, build=tsc -b && copy migrations, dev=tsx watch src/main.ts; deps hono ^4, @hono/node-server, drizzle-orm ^0.38, drizzle-kit ^0.30, pg, jose, argon2, pino, zod ^4, @medbridge/contracts workspace:*; devDeps typescript, tsx, vitest ^2, @testcontainers/postgresql, @types/node, @types/pg), tsconfig.json (extends tsconfig.base.json, outDir dist, rootDir src), and vitest.config.ts (projects pattern with two suites: unit colocated as src/**/*.test.ts and integration under test/integration/**/*.test.ts; testTimeout 60000 for integration to accommodate testcontainers).

tasks.title: Compose Hono app, mount /api/health and auth routes, boot HTTP server
tasks.description: Author apps/api/src/main.ts to: (a) call loadEnv(process.env) on first line — boot crashes here if JWT_SECRET missing/short, matching enriched bullet 10; (b) instantiate the pg Pool + Drizzle db; (c) build a Hono app, register requestId → logger → cors → errorHandler middleware globally; (d) mount GET /api/health → `{ ok: true }` (un-authenticated per ARCHITECTURE §6.1); (e) attach csrf + authn + authz to the /api/* router; (f) wire the auth module via auth/index.ts; (g) start serve() from @hono/node-server on PORT env (default 3000). The function exports `buildApp(env)` separately from the side-effect main entry so integration tests can construct an app without binding a port — this is what the JWT_SECRET fail-fast test imports.

tasks.title: argon2id password hashing + verify wrapper with DI seam
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/modules/auth/passwords.ts exporting a PasswordHasher interface { hash(plain: string): Promise<string>; verify(hash: string, plain: string): Promise<boolean> } and a defaultPasswordHasher implementation using argon2 (type=argon2id, memoryCost=19456, timeCost=2, parallelism=1 per OWASP minimum). The DI seam (interface) is what auth.service consumes — production wires defaultPasswordHasher; integration tests inject a vi.fn-spied implementation so they can assert `verify` was invoked exactly once for both unknown-email and wrong-password code paths (enriched bullet 14).
context: .planning/features/api-scaffold-auth.enriched.md acceptance bullets 7 + 14 (constant-time verify, DI seam for spy)

tasks.title: Auth repo with atomic refresh-rotation SQL and token-family revoke
tasks.description: Implement apps/api/src/modules/auth/repo.ts as the only file touching the Drizzle client for auth. Functions: findUserByEmail(email): Promise<User | undefined> (citext lookup, soft-delete-filtered), insertUser({email, role, passwordHash}) for the seed only, insertRefreshToken({userId, hash, expiresAt}), rotateRefreshToken(hash): Promise<RotatedRow | null> — implemented as the single atomic SQL `UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked_at = now() WHERE hash = $1 AND revoked_at IS NULL RETURNING id, user_id, expires_at` (returns null on zero rows), findRefreshTokenAnywhere(hash) for replay detection, revokeAllActiveForUser(userId) for token-family revocation (`UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked_at = now() WHERE user_id = $1 AND revoked_at IS NULL`). All queries use Drizzle's `sql` template / db.execute and parameter binding — never string interpolate.
context: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.3 (repo.ts is the only db-touching file in the module)

custom.cmd: rg --quiet "UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked_at = now\(\) WHERE hash" apps/api/src/modules/auth/repo.ts

tasks.title: Auth Hono routes (auth.login/logout/refresh/me) + module index public surface
tasks.description: Add apps/api/src/modules/auth/routes.ts as a Hono router declaring POST /auth.login (Zod parse loginRequest, call service.login, on success set the three cookies via http.ts helpers and respond loginResponse), POST /auth.logout (read refresh cookie raw value, call service.logout, clear all three cookies), POST /auth.refresh (read refresh cookie, call service.refresh, set the new cookies, respond refreshResponse), GET /auth.me (call service.me using ctx.user.userId attached by authn). auth.login and auth.refresh are CSRF-exempt and authn-exempt (login bootstraps the session); auth.logout and auth.me require CSRF + authn. Also add apps/api/src/modules/auth/index.ts as the public surface — re-exports createAuthService and the wireAuth(router, deps) helper that mounts the routes.

tasks.title: Drizzle auth schema (user + refresh_token) plus initial migration enabling pgcrypto/citext
tasks.description: Author apps/api/src/modules/auth/schema.ts defining two Drizzle tables: `user` (id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), email citext not null unique, role text not null check (role in ('patient','doctor')), password_hash text not null, created_at timestamptz not null default now(), deleted_at timestamptz null) and `refresh_token` (id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid not null references user(id) on delete restrict, hash text not null unique, issued_at timestamptz not null default now(), expires_at timestamptz not null, revoked_at timestamptz null, replaced_by uuid null references refresh_token(id)). Re-export both tables from apps/api/src/db/schema.ts. Run `drizzle-kit generate` (or hand-author the SQL) to produce apps/api/src/db/migrations/0000_initial.sql with `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;`, `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext;`, and the two CREATE TABLE statements; commit the matching meta/_journal.json + meta/0000_snapshot.json. The user table is the minimal shape per enriched bullet 9 — downstream `accounts` will adopt and extend it; do NOT add a second user table later.
context: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.2 (auth owns user_credential + refresh_token — collapsed into user here per clarification)

custom.cmd: rg --quiet "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto" apps/api/src/db/migrations/0000_initial.sql
rg --quiet "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext" apps/api/src/db/migrations/0000_initial.sql

tasks.title: Auth service: login/refresh/logout/me with DI for argon2 verify + token-family revoke
tasks.description: Implement apps/api/src/modules/auth/service.ts as a `createAuthService({ repo, hasher, clock, logger })` factory returning { login, logout, refresh, me }. Behaviour: login(email, plain) → repo.findUserByEmail(email); ALWAYS calls hasher.verify (with a fake stored hash if no user, so unknown-email and wrong-password branch through the same number of verify calls — exactly one, per enriched bullet 14); on success returns { user, sessionJwt, refreshTokenRaw, csrfToken }, on failure throws UnauthorizedError. refresh(refreshRaw) → hashes the raw value, calls repo.rotateRefreshToken; if null and the hash exists anywhere, invoke repo.revokeAllActiveForUser + log a single warn line { msg: 'refresh.replay_detected', userId, requestId } then throw UnauthorizedError; if null and not present, plain UnauthorizedError. logout(refreshRaw) → revoke just that row. me(userId) → repo.findUserById. The factory keeps every collaborator DI-able for unit tests to spy on hasher.verify and assert it is called exactly once per login attempt.

tasks.title: JWT sign/verify via jose + boot-time JWT_SECRET fail-fast bootstrap
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/modules/auth/tokens.ts exposing createSessionToken({ userId, role }, secret, ttlSeconds): Promise<string> and verifySessionToken(jwt, secret): Promise<{ userId; role }>. Use jose's SignJWT/jwtVerify with HS256 over a TextEncoder.encode(secret) key. Also export createRefreshTokenValue() (32-byte cryptographically random string) and hashRefreshToken(raw): Promise<string> (sha-256 — refresh tokens are revoked-on-use server-side, so a fast hash is appropriate). The module reads env via the loadEnv factory so the JWT_SECRET fail-fast check from task-shared-env is exercised on first import; passing an undersized secret to loadEnv must throw before the module's exports are reachable.

tasks.title: Author Zod auth contracts: login/refresh/me/logout request and response schemas
tasks.description: Add packages/contracts/src/auth.ts with Zod v4 schemas: loginRequest (email z.string().email(), password z.string().min(1)), loginResponse ({ user: { id: brandedUserId, email, role: z.enum(['patient','doctor']) } }), meResponse (same user shape), logoutRequest (empty object), refreshRequest (empty body), refreshResponse (same as login). Also add errorEnvelope schema ({ error: { code: z.enum(['UNAUTHORIZED','FORBIDDEN','VALIDATION','NOT_FOUND','CONFLICT','PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE','UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA','INTERNAL']), message: z.string(), details: z.unknown().optional() } }) and the AuthErrorCode union. Export z.infer types alongside each schema. Re-export everything from packages/contracts/src/index.ts.

tasks.title: Scaffold packages/contracts skeleton with zod + barrel + vitest config
tasks.description: Create packages/contracts as a TypeScript-only workspace package: package.json (name @medbridge/contracts, exports './src/index.ts', deps on zod ^4 and devDeps on typescript + vitest), tsconfig.json extending tsconfig.base.json with composite + emitDeclarationOnly, src/index.ts as an empty barrel ready for downstream re-exports, and vitest.config.ts (empty test glob, here only so pnpm -r test does not fail).
context: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.1 + §6.2 (packages/contracts is the only cross-app shared code)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §5.2 (error envelope schema lives in contracts)

tasks.title: Drizzle config, db client pool, and schema barrel
tasks.description: Add apps/api/drizzle.config.ts (schema './src/db/schema.ts', out './src/db/migrations', dialect 'postgresql', dbCredentials.url from env.DATABASE_URL), apps/api/src/db/client.ts exporting createDb(pool: Pg.Pool) and a default singleton db built from a pg Pool sized from env, and apps/api/src/db/schema.ts as the Drizzle barrel that re-exports module schemas (initially empty — downstream tasks add the imports).

tasks.title: docker-compose stack: postgres, api-migrate (migrate+seed), api with healthcheck
tasks.description: Author docker-compose.yml with three services: postgres (image postgres:17-alpine, env POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB from .env, volume pgdata, healthcheck pg_isready -U $POSTGRES_USER); api-migrate (builds apps/api/Dockerfile target 'migrate', depends_on postgres condition: service_healthy, command sh -c 'pnpm drizzle-kit migrate && node dist/seed/main.js', restart: 'no' — one-shot); api (same image target 'runtime', depends_on api-migrate condition: service_completed_successfully + postgres healthy, environment DATABASE_URL/JWT_SECRET/UPLOAD_DIR/LOG_LEVEL/PORT, ports 3000:3000, healthcheck `wget --spider -q http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1` with interval 5s/start_period 10s/retries 6). Add apps/api/Dockerfile multi-stage: base (node:25-alpine + corepack pnpm), deps (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile in a workspace-aware copy), build (pnpm --filter @medbridge/api build), migrate target (CMD running drizzle-kit migrate + seed), runtime target (CMD node dist/main.js).

tasks.title: Hono middleware chain: requestId, logger, errorHandler, csrf, authn, authz
tasks.description: Author six Hono middlewares under apps/api/src/middleware/ in the order they compose per ARCHITECTURE §3.1: requestId.ts (mints uuid, attaches ctx.requestId + sets X-Request-Id response header), logger.ts (opens child logger via shared/logger.withRequestId, emits one structured line per request with {requestId, method, path, status, durationMs, userId?}), errorHandler.ts (catches AppError → JSON `{ error: { code, message, details? } }` with mapped HTTP status; unknown errors → 500 with logger.error and no internal leak; zod ZodError → ValidationError with issues as details), csrf.ts (double-submit: on state-changing methods (POST/PATCH/DELETE) compare csrf_token cookie to X-CSRF-Token header with crypto.timingSafeEqual; mismatch throws ForbiddenError), authn.ts (reads session cookie, calls verifySessionToken, attaches ctx.user; missing/invalid → UnauthorizedError unless route is allow-listed via context property), authz.ts (exports requireRole('patient' | 'doctor') wrapper that checks ctx.user.role).

tasks.title: Idempotent seed inserting one patient and one doctor with hashed credentials
tasks.description: Implement apps/api/src/seed/main.ts as a one-shot Node entry: loadEnv, build the pg pool/db, then upsert two users — patient (email: patient@medbridge.test, role: patient) and doctor (email: doctor@medbridge.test, role: doctor) — each with a password hashed via defaultPasswordHasher using the seeded literal 'CorrectHorseBatteryStaple1!' (sourced from env SEED_PASSWORD with that default; documented in .env.example). Use `ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING` (or a SELECT-first guard) so re-running on a populated DB inserts zero rows. Exit 0 in all success paths, log a single info line summarising rows inserted. The file's shebang or a dedicated 'seed' bin script lets the api-migrate container run `node dist/seed/main.js` after drizzle-kit migrate completes.
context: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4.3 (seed runs as separate one-shot after migrate)

tasks.title: Implement env parsing with fail-fast JWT_SECRET length check
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/shared/env.ts that defines a Zod schema for required env vars (DATABASE_URL z.string().url(), JWT_SECRET z.string().min(32, 'JWT_SECRET must be at least 32 bytes'), SESSION_TTL z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(900), REFRESH_TTL z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(604800), UPLOAD_DIR z.string().default('/var/lib/medbridge/uploads'), LOG_LEVEL z.enum(['debug','info','warn','error']).default('info'), NODE_ENV z.enum(['development','production','test']).default('development')) and a `loadEnv(source: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env)` factory that calls schema.parse(source) and throws a clear Error on failure. Export the parsed singleton `env`. The factory shape allows the JWT_SECRET fail-fast test to feed a short secret and expect a throw.

tasks.title: Implement AppError taxonomy in apps/api/src/shared/errors.ts
tasks.description: Implement the full AppError class hierarchy per ARCHITECTURE §5.2: base AppError(code, message, status, details?) extending Error; concrete subclasses ValidationError (422 / 'VALIDATION'), UnauthorizedError (401 / 'UNAUTHORIZED'), ForbiddenError (403 / 'FORBIDDEN'), NotFoundError (404 / 'NOT_FOUND'), ConflictError (409 / 'CONFLICT'), UnsupportedMediaError (415 / 'UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA'), PayloadTooLargeError (413 / 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE'). Each subclass sets `name` and `code` literal so an `instanceof AppError` check in errorHandler can serialise consistently. Export a discriminated-union ErrorCode literal type for typed consumption.

tasks.title: Implement pino logger with redaction in apps/api/src/shared/logger.ts
tasks.description: Create a pino base logger with redaction paths covering ARCHITECTURE §5.3's 'Never log' list: redact ['req.headers.cookie','req.headers[\'x-csrf-token\']','req.body.password','*.password','*.token','*.refreshToken','*.csrfToken','*.jwt'] with censor='[REDACTED]'. Export the base logger plus a withRequestId(requestId, userId?) helper that returns a child logger binding {requestId, userId}. Level driven by env.LOG_LEVEL.

tasks.title: Implement shared helpers: time clock, uuid id generator, http cookie helpers
tasks.description: Add three small helper modules under apps/api/src/shared/: time.ts (exports Clock interface { now(): Date } + a defaultClock so service-layer code can DI a fake clock in tests), ids.ts (newUuid via node:crypto.randomUUID, plus a branded UserId/RefreshTokenId nominal-type helper), http.ts (cookie option presets: sessionCookieOptions/refreshCookieOptions HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=Lax, csrfCookieOptions HttpOnly=false+SameSite=Lax, plus parseCookies(headerValue) helper).

tasks.title: Terminal smoke: workspace install, typecheck, lint, build, and full test suite
tasks.description: Final smoke wave gate — runs no code changes; verifies the workspace as a whole installs, typechecks, lints, builds, and that the complete vitest suite (unit + integration) passes end-to-end across apps/api and packages/contracts. Acts as the implicit covering check for acceptance bullet 1 (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + `pnpm -r typecheck` succeed) and the integration-suite green signal for bullets 3-14.

tasks.title: Integration tests for auth.login/refresh/me/logout and CSRF rejection
tasks.description: Author five integration test files under apps/api/test/integration/, each spinning up its own pg container via the support harness, building buildApp(env), and exercising the corresponding flow. (1) auth.login.test.ts — happy path: 200 + HttpOnly+Secure session and refresh_token cookies + non-HttpOnly csrf_token cookie + body `{ user: { id, email, role } }`; sad path: invalid email and wrong password each return 401 + `{ error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' } }` + zero Set-Cookie. (2) auth.refresh.test.ts — first call rotates: new refresh cookie value differs from the original; old hash row has revoked_at set; new row exists with new hash; replayed original cookie returns 401. (3) auth.me.test.ts — valid session cookie returns the seeded user; missing/invalid cookie returns 401. (4) auth.logout.test.ts — clears session + refresh cookies (Max-Age=0 or expired); active refresh_token row is revoked. (5) auth.csrf.test.ts — POST /api/auth.logout without an X-CSRF-Token header but with valid session cookie returns 403 + `{ error: { code: 'FORBIDDEN' } }`; mismatched header value returns 403; matching value succeeds.

tests: pnpm --filter @medbridge/api exec vitest run test/integration/auth.login.test.ts test/integration/auth.refresh.test.ts test/integration/auth.me.test.ts test/integration/auth.logout.test.ts test/integration/auth.csrf.test.ts

tasks.title: Integration tests: argon2 constant-time, log scrub, JWT boot fail-fast, concurrent rotation, family revoke, seed idempotency
tasks.description: Author six adversarial integration tests covering the harder acceptance bullets. (1) auth.constant-time.test.ts — buildApp with hasher: { verify: vi.fn(defaultPasswordHasher.verify), hash: ... }; POST /auth.login with an unknown email asserts hasher.verify called exactly once; POST /auth.login with a known email + wrong password asserts the same; both return 401 (closes enriched bullets 7 + 14). (2) auth.log-scrub.test.ts — wire the request via a logger built on createLogCapture(); replay login/refresh/me/logout flows; assert no captured line contains the seeded password, any session JWT value, any refresh cookie raw value, or the csrf_token cookie value (uses notContainsAny). (3) auth.boot-jwt-secret.test.ts — call buildApp({ ...env, JWT_SECRET: 'too-short' }) and expect a thrown Error whose message mentions JWT_SECRET + 32 (matches enriched bullet 10). (4) auth.concurrent-refresh.test.ts — performs login, captures the refresh cookie, fires two Promise.all'd POST /auth.refresh requests with the same raw cookie; asserts exactly one resolves 200 with a new pair and the other resolves 401 (enriched bullet 11). (5) auth.token-family.test.ts — login → refresh (rotates) → replay the original cookie; assert 401, assert SELECT revoked_at FROM refresh_token WHERE user_id = $1 AND revoked_at IS NULL returns zero rows, assert captured log has exactly one warn line containing both `userId` and `requestId` (enriched bullet 12). (6) seed.idempotent.test.ts — run apps/api/src/seed/main.ts twice against the same container; first run inserts 2 user rows, second run inserts 0 and exits 0; final row count remains 2 (enriched bullet 13).

tests: pnpm --filter @medbridge/api exec vitest run test/integration/auth.constant-time.test.ts test/integration/auth.log-scrub.test.ts test/integration/auth.boot-jwt-secret.test.ts test/integration/auth.concurrent-refresh.test.ts test/integration/auth.token-family.test.ts test/integration/seed.idempotent.test.ts

tasks.title: Integration test harness: testcontainers pg-per-file, request helper, log capture
tasks.description: Author the apps/api/test/support layer that every integration test consumes. db.ts: startPostgresContainer() returns { db, pool, container, applyMigrations(), reset() } using @testcontainers/postgresql (Postgres 17 image), runs drizzle-kit migrate on connect, returns a typed Drizzle db. request.ts: createRequestAgent(app) wrapping app.request that maintains a cookie jar (so successive calls carry session/refresh/csrf cookies), and a csrfHeaders() helper that lifts the csrf_token cookie value into X-CSRF-Token. fixtures.ts: insertSeedUsers(db) → { patientId, doctorId } hashing with defaultPasswordHasher; truncate() helper that wipes refresh_token + user between tests. logCapture.ts: createLogCapture() returns a pino destination ({ write }) recording lines, plus assertions notContainsAny(lines, [secrets...]) used by the log-scrub test. passwords.ts: re-export the seeded plaintext literal so tests don't duplicate it.
context: .planning/features/api-scaffold-auth.enriched.md (all integration acceptance bullets need this harness)
.planning/intel/test-layout.md (do not mock the database; one pg per file)

tasks.title: Unit tests for auth.service with mocked repo + spied argon2 verify
tasks.description: Author apps/api/src/modules/auth/service.test.ts (colocated, no Postgres) using vi.fn-mocked repo + hasher. Cases: login happy path (verify called once, repo.insertRefreshToken called once, returns user + tokens); login unknown email (repo.findUserByEmail returns undefined, hasher.verify STILL called exactly once with a dummy hash, throws UnauthorizedError); login wrong password (repo returns user, hasher.verify resolves false, called exactly once, throws UnauthorizedError); refresh happy (repo.rotateRefreshToken returns a row, new token pair issued, no warn log); refresh replay (rotate returns null + findRefreshTokenAnywhere returns the existing row, calls repo.revokeAllActiveForUser, emits one warn log line, throws UnauthorizedError); logout revokes the specified row. Each assertion uses expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(n).

tasks.title: Scaffold pnpm workspace root with biome, tsconfig base, ignores, env example
tasks.description: Create the monorepo root: package.json (with pnpm@10 packageManager pin, scripts for typecheck/test/build/lint via -r), pnpm-workspace.yaml listing apps/* and packages/*, tsconfig.base.json (strict, ESNext, moduleResolution NodeNext), biome.json (formatter + linter, recommended rules), .npmrc (auto-install-peers=true, shamefully-hoist=false), .gitignore (node_modules, dist, .env, uploads/), .env.example (DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, SESSION_TTL, REFRESH_TTL, UPLOAD_DIR, LOG_LEVEL placeholders), and .dockerignore.
